items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.summary: We’ve launched Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), the successor to Claude Fable 5 for long-running agentic coding, knowledge work, and research. For Project Glasswing participants, we’ve also launched Claude Mythos 5.1 (claude-mythos-5-1). Both models support a 1M token context window by default, 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking. They cost $10 / $50 USD per MTok, the same as Claude Fable 5, with cache reads cut to $0.25 USD per MTok. Claude Fable 5.1 is available on the Claude API, Claude in Amazon Bedrock, and Claude Platform on AWS. It’s also on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed) and Claude in Microsoft Foundry. See Claude Fable 5.1 for specifications.
